elements.requirement: Any provision that purports to bind a tenant as to the means of giving a notice in writing to quit premises let under an assured tenancy has no effect.
elements.quote: Any provision that would bind a tenant as to the means of giving a notice in writing to quit premises let under an assured tenancy is of no effect.

elements.requirement: The means of giving a notice in writing is defined as the mode by which the words of the notice are represented or reproduced in a visible form.
elements.quote: the mode by which the words of the notice are represented or reproduced in a visible form

elements.requirement: A notice given by a tenant to quit premises let under an assured tenancy may be withdrawn before it takes effect if the tenant and landlord agree to the withdrawal in writing.
elements.quote: may be withdrawn before the date on which it takes effect by the tenant and landlord agreeing in writing to the withdrawal

elements.requirement: In the case of a joint assured tenancy, an agreement to withdraw a notice to quit is valid only if it is made between the landlord and all of the tenants.
elements.quote: is not valid unless it is made between the landlord and all of the tenants

elements.requirement: The requirement for all joint tenants to agree to a withdrawal does not affect the validity of a notice to quit premises let under a joint assured tenancy given by only one or some of the tenants.
elements.quote: That does not affect the validity of any notice to quit premises let under a joint assured tenancy that is given by only one or some of the tenants.

elements.requirement: A joint assured tenancy is defined as an assured tenancy where two or more persons are tenants under the tenancy.
elements.quote: an assured tenancy where two or more persons are tenants under the tenancy

thresholds.what: minimum number of persons holding a tenancy for it to constitute a joint assured tenancy
thresholds.quote: two or more persons are tenants under the tenancy
